purpose: Govern admission of child-project and capability-lane outputs into the Book System without transferring qualification authority or allowing subordinate work to mutate parent canonical state implicitly.
eligible_sources: future Book System capability lanes explicitly registered by parent authority
fail_closed_rules: No child output is ADMITTED merely because its branch CI or A-01 qualification passes.
No exact-SHA evidence may be cited as qualifying a different implementation SHA.
No provider, prose engine or evaluator output writes parent canonical book state directly unless a parent contract explicitly grants that mutation for the exact admitted interface.
Human-gold, author-decision, rights, private-data and publication boundaries remain separate authorities and cannot be synthesized by integration metadata.
Unknown or incomplete rights/provenance blocks admission of the affected payload or derivation.
A parent admission may bind a qualified capability interface without merging or rewriting the child branch history.
On uncertainty, retain current parent behavior/state and classify the proposal DEFERRED rather than silently integrating.

prose_project_binding.allowed_parent_interaction: Submit bounded integration proposals for qualified capabilities and requested parent contract/interface changes.

book_evaluator_binding.evidence_role: Provide evaluation/qualification evidence under its own privacy, split-isolation and exact-SHA boundaries.

literary_reference_binding.shared_use: Supports evaluator calibration and Prose drafting/revision craft retrieval under rights/provenance constraints.

parent_admission_decision_must_record: exact admitted source SHA or immutable artifact identity
whether canonical mutation is permitted and under what guard
qualification_effect: NONE by creation alone. This is a governance/interface contract. It does not promote Prose, close Book Eval Gate D, transfer A-01 authority, create human gold, or authorize publication.
